name: Irina Valerievna Morozova
bio:
Irina's motorsport journey began unexpectedly. After years in international shipping, a chance encounter with a struggling racing team needing logistical support sparked a passion. She quickly realized her skills in coordinating complex global operations were perfectly suited for the fast-paced world of racing. Irina joined Hitech GP five years ago and has since become an indispensable part of the team.

Irina's approach is meticulous and proactive. She believes in anticipating problems before they arise, ensuring that equipment and personnel are always where they need to be, when they need to be there. Her deep understanding of international regulations and customs procedures, coupled with her relentless attention to detail, is what allows Hitech GP to operate seamlessly across the globe. Irina is known for her ability to handle any logistical challenge with calm efficiency, making her a highly valued asset.

What sets Irina apart is her ability to see the bigger picture. She doesn't just manage logistics; she strategically optimizes them, constantly seeking ways to improve efficiency and reduce costs. This forward-thinking approach, coupled with her unwavering dedication, makes her a true visionary in her field.

physical.hairStyle: Neatly styled shoulder-length bob with subtle waves
physical.description: Irina is a woman of medium height with a composed demeanor and a warm, engaging smile.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn notebook filled with logistical charts and schedules.
Insists on drinking green tea with lemon every morning at precisely 9:00 AM.
Has a habit of speaking in logistical jargon, even in casual conversation.
